lead.event: GOTO reports Q3 2026 profit as commission cap weighs on mobility
lead.headline: GOTO reports Rp441 billion Q3 2026 profit as 8% cap weighs on mobility
lead.blurb: GoTo’s net revenue rose 17% year on year to Rp5.6 trillion, while core gross transaction value climbed 89% to Rp194 trillion. Mobility adjusted EBITDA fell 16% year on year to Rp159 billion, as the 8% commission cap effective 1 July cut GoRide profitability by an estimated Rp150 billion in the quarter. Management said this was the first full quarter reflecting the cap and expects two-wheeler transport to move toward breakeven, with Delivery also supporting on-demand services.

earnings_guidance.event: Bayan Resources reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BYAN reports 12.93% nine-month 2026 net profit growth to USD589.67 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: For the period ended 30 September, revenue was USD2.43 billion, roughly flat year on year, while gross profit rose to USD864.03 million from USD773.35 million. Earnings per share increased to USD0.018 from USD0.016, and total assets reached USD3.49 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom reports nine-month 2026 revenue growth and lower attributable profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM reports 3.55% revenue growth and lower attributable profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Telkom's January-September revenue reached Rp113.50 trillion, up from Rp109.61 trillion a year earlier, while attributable profit fell to Rp14.44 trillion from Rp15.03 trillion. Internet and mobile data services contributed Rp56.57 trillion, and IndiHome Rp19.12 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: VKTR reports nine-month 2026 revenue and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: VKTR reports 49% revenue and 47% profit growth in 9M 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: VKTR's electric vehicle sales contributed Rp186 billion and automotive parts Rp880 billion. Net profit reached Rp12.1 billion, while assets stood at Rp2.03 trillion at end-September, up 13% YTD. The company is targeting completion of electric bus orders by end-2026 and is expanding with light-duty truck chassis deliveries and its e-MaaS scheme.

earnings_guidance.event: SSMS reports nine-month 2026 revenue and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: SSMS reports 34.85% revenue and 71.26% total profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sawit Sumbermas Sarana reported revenue of Rp14.83 trillion for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, up from Rp11.00 trillion a year earlier, led by CPO and derivative products. Profit attributable to parent owners rose 58.43% to Rp1.59 trillion.
